latest_release.name: v1.11.7
latest_release.body:
> 请访问 [更新日志](https://vant-ui.github.io/vant-weapp/#/changelog) 了解所有更新。

## What's Changed
* chore(workflow): generate changelog via GitHub by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5800
* chore: bump @vant/cli v7 by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5801
* feat(Cascader): add ellipsis prop support by @landluck in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5806
* docs: add new document site URL by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5810
* docs: redirect from the old domain by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5811
* feat(uploader): add preview-file prop support by @landluck in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5828
* build(deps): bump ws from 7.5.6 to 7.5.10 by @dependabot in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5823
* fix(notice-bar): fix inconsistent rolling rates by @landluck in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5910
* fix(uploader): fix prop referrer-policy no effect by @landluck in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5909
* fix(stepper): fix unable input decimal in Stepper component by @landluck in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5908
* fix(dialog):  prevent unintended closure of nested dialogs by @landluck in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5907
* fix(steps): resolve last node alignment issue when desc is empty by @landluck in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5906
* fix(collapse): ensure border property correctly disables bottom border by @landluck in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5905
* fix(image): resolve extra spacing issue at bottom by @landluck in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5904
* build(deps): bump rollup from 4.18.0 to 4.22.4 by @dependabot in https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/pull/5897


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/youzan/vant-weapp/compare/v1.11.6...v1.11.7
